title: chore: remove GSoC app
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Removes only the obsolete `apps/gsoc` application.
- Drops its deployment registration and replaces the stale GSoC manual-deploy example.
- Reflects that Pollinations is not participating in GSoC 2026.
- Validated with Biome, JSON parsing, reference checks, and the deployment-consumer test.

Deployment note: the existing Cloudflare project or domain can be retired separately after merge.

gist.headline: The old garden plot rests
gist.blurb: The retired GSoC app and its deployment entry have been gently cleared away. The hive's map now matches 2026: no GSoC stop this season.
gist.summary: Removed the obsolete apps/gsoc application, its seven-entry deployment registration, and the stale manual-deploy example now that Pollinations is not participating in GSoC 2026.
gist.impact: Deployment consumers and repository contributors now see an accurate app registry and no longer encounter the retired GSoC 2026 materials.
gist.visual_concept: A cozy garden-shed cleanup represents retiring an obsolete community application: Polli carefully packs a small old GSoC sign and code printouts into a labeled archive box while a deployment map has the corresponding garden plot neatly cleared. Keep the mood warm and respectful rather than mournful, with fresh flowers and sprouts showing that the community garden continues growing.
